articles.summary: After outgrowing Glofox, 444 Pilates founder Ashley Yono switched to Arketa to simplify operations and elevate her client experience. With a branded app, seamless booking, and responsive support, she’s been able to focus on what matters most—building her community and growing her studio.
articles.title: From Glofox to Arketa: How 444 Pilates Found a Platform That Truly Fit
